title: Anthropic Lowers Cost of Claude by 40% for All US Government Agencies
summary:
The provider of the Claude AI assistant has renegotiated its procurement terms with the U.S. General Services Administration to make its software more affordable for public officials. Under a new OneGov agreement, Anthropic is providing a 40% discount on its products to agencies at the federal, state, local, tribal, and territorial levels, with the pricing available immediately through the GSA's multiple award schedule.

As part of the expansion, the company is launching a dedicated program to assist government agencies in optimizing their usage of the chatbot. Additionally, Anthropic stated that its Claude Enterprise offering is pursuing FedRAMP Moderate approval through the FedRAMP 20x program.
